lens: Prospective applicant — first encounter (simulated AI user lens)
reason: The sampled applicant flow is thoughtfully structured: eligibility, preparation, evaluation traits and recruitment stages are available before account creation. The public desktop/mobile hero captures show coherent Precision Instrument typography, clear actions and a legible process figure. Source and supplied browser logs support explicit save acknowledgements, a separate final submission action, preserved competing answers, paused writes during conflict selection and recovery from uncertain submission responses. The status source prioritizes bookings/offers and distinguishes schedule failure from having nothing to do. However, the post-submit privacy promise remains misleading, and the successful synthetic journeys do not establish successful account creation, real uploads, submission and status retrieval through hosted services. I cannot give an unqualified world-class agreement from this evidence. Hold for the copy correction and integrated applicant acceptance evidence; this is an AI source/evidence assessment, not observed student success.

findings.evidence: The Application received banner says written responses will enter “anonymous first-pass review.” MaterialsStep and ReviewStep in src/app/apply/application-form.tsx:731 and :746 explicitly disclose that assigned reviewers can also view the original identifying resume. The release-open-items Blind review entry says anonymous resume review must not be claimed pending policy resolution.
findings.userImpact: At the moment of successful submission, a first-time applicant receives an anonymity assurance that obscures the reviewer’s ability to connect responses with their identity. It undermines the more accurate disclosure shown before consent.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace “anonymous first-pass review” with the precise packet boundary: profile fields are omitted from the written-response packet, while assigned reviewers can also access the original resume. Add a focused assertion for the actual confirmation copy.
